description: Self-hosted web file manager for managing files in a specified directory.
notes: SECURITY WARNING: Upstream archived this project on 2026-09-01 and announced that no further releases or security fixes are planned.

Upstream documents unresolved command-execution and session/JWT risks. Keep command runners/hooks disabled, do not expose the service directly to the public internet, use independent authentication in front of it, and run it with least privilege and access limited to the intended files.
